snippet.title: FATAL FRAME II: Crimson Butterfly REMAKE - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Website - https://www.koeitecmoamerica.com/fatalframe/crimson-re/

FATAL FRAME II: Crimson Butterfly REMAKE is now available on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Switch 2 and Steam for PC.

Twin sisters, Mio and Mayu, find themselves lost in an abandoned village haunted by vengeful spirits. Using a camera called the Camera Obscura that captures and seals the impossible, they battle spirits in this Japanese-style horror adventure game.

A free demo is also available and your save data carries over to the full game!

#FatalFrame #FATALFRAMEIIREMAKE #CrimsonButterflyRemake
